routes.label: Find the discount on the total cost

question: Karl bought five folders from Pay-A-Lot at a cost of \(\$2.50\) each. Pay-A-Lot had a \(20\%\)-off sale the following day. How much could Karl have saved on the purchase by waiting a day?
solution:
The five folders cost \(5\times\$2.50=\$12.50\). A \(20\%\)-off sale saves \(20\%\) of the original cost. Since \(20\%=\tfrac15\), Karl could have saved
\[
\$12.50\div5=\boxed{\$2.50},
\]
choice C.
